versions.text: (a) Each passenger and crew com partment must be ventilated, and each crew com partment must have enough fresh air (but not less than 0.3 m3 (10 cu ft) per m inute per crew m ember) to let crew m embers perform their duties without undue discom fort or fatigue. (b) Crew and passenger com partment air m ust be free from harm ful or hazardous concentrations of gases or vapours. (c) The concentration of carbon m onoxide may not exceed one part in 20 000 parts of air during forward flight. If the concentration exceeds this value under other conditions, there m ust be suitable operating restrictions. (d) There m ust be m eans to ensure compliance with sub-paragraphs (b) and (c) under any reasonably probable failure of any ventilating, heating, or other system or equipment.
